_comment: Hand-picked articles pinned to the TOP of the news area. This file is never rewritten by the news bot, unlike data/news.json, which is rebuilt from scratch every three hours - so an article added here stays put instead of rotating off within a day. Each entry reserves its own slot, so the day's scraped news cannot push it off. To add one, copy a block and fill it in. To take one down early, delete the block or change 'until' to a past date.

_fields.title: required - shown as the headline
_fields.url: required - where the card links to
_fields.image: full https url to the article's picture; omit for no image
_fields.excerpt: one or two sentences shown under the headline
_fields.outlet: publication name, e.g. TAPinto or NJ.com
_fields.school: optional, which member school it concerns
_fields.until: LAST day it shows, YYYY-MM-DD. It disappears by itself the next day. Omit to keep it until removed by hand.

sticky.title: 19th Cheer for the Cure a Huge Success at Bloomfield High, with Tremendous Enthusiasm and Accolades Honoring the Late Karen Centinaro
sticky.excerpt: The 19th annual Cheer for the Cure cheerleading competition filled Foley Field in Bloomfield on the evening of Oct. 6, honoring the late Karen Centinaro.
